classification.difficultyReason: Students must exclude the top face of both an open cylinder and an open box, find each surface area, and compare them. The cylinder is exact and then rounded. This is similar to p28-q4, with the extra open-top interpretation, but it is simpler than p28-q5, which needs unit coverage and rounding up.

content.prompt: Which tank has the greater surface area? Each tank is open at the top. Give the difference to the nearest $0.1\text{ m}^2$.

answer.short: Tank Q has the greater surface area, by $7.1\text{ m}^2$.
answer.worked:
Tank P has radius $r=3\div2=1.5\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{P}}&=\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\A_{\text{P}}&=\pi(1.5)^2+2\pi(1.5)(2)\\A_{\text{P}}&=8.25\pi\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Tank Q, with the top omitted:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{Q}}&=3\times3+4(3\times2)\\A_{\text{Q}}&=33\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference}&=33-8.25\pi\\\text{Difference}&\approx7.1\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Tank Q has the greater surface area.
